entries.title: Exodus 18:1
segments: ¶And Jethro the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, heard of all that God had done to Moses, and to Israel his people; that Jehovah had brought Israel out of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 18:2
segments: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

entries.title: Exodus 18:3
segments: and her two sons, of whom the name of the one was Gershom--for he said, I have been a sojourner in a foreign land,

entries.title: Exodus 18:4
segments: --and the name of the other, Eliezer--For the God of my father has been my help, and has delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.

entries.title: Exodus 18:5
segments: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came to Moses with his sons and his wife into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mountain of God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:6
segments: And he sent word to Moses: I, thy father-in-law Jethro, am come to thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

entries.title: Exodus 18:7
segments: ¶And Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other [after] their welfare, and went into the tent.

entries.title: Exodus 18:8
segments: And Moses told his father-in-law all that Jehovah had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake; all the trouble that had befallen them on the way, and [how] Jehovah had delivered them.

entries.title: Exodus 18:9
segments: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness that Jehovah had done to Israel; that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 18:10
segments: And Jethro said, Blessed be Jehovah, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 18:11
segments: Now I know that Jehovah is greater than all gods; for in the thing in which they acted haughtily [he was] above them.

entries.title: Exodus 18:12
segments: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took a burnt-offering and sacrifices for God; and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law in the presence of God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:13
segments: ¶And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people; and the people stood by Moses from the morning to the evening.

entries.title: Exodus 18:14
segments: And Moses' father-in-law saw all that he did with the people, and said, What is this thing which thou art doing with the people? why dost thou sit alone, and all the people are standing by thee from morning to evening?

entries.title: Exodus 18:15
segments: And Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to enquire of God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:16
segments: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between one and another; and I make known [to them] the statutes of God, and his laws.

entries.title: Exodus 18:17
segments: And Moses' father-in-law said to him, The thing that thou art doing is not good.

entries.title: Exodus 18:18
segments: Thou wilt be quite exhausted, both thou and this people that is with thee; for the thing is too heavy for thee: thou canst not perform it alone.

entries.title: Exodus 18:19
segments: Hearken now to my voice: I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee. Be thou for the people with God, and bring the matters before God;

entries.title: Exodus 18:20
segments: and teach them the statutes and the laws, and make known to them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

entries.title: Exodus 18:21
segments: But do thou provide among all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place [them] over them, chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of fifties, and chiefs of tens,

entries.title: Exodus 18:22
segments: that they may judge the people at all times; and it shall be [that] they shall bring to thee every great matter, and that they shall judge every small matter, and they shall lighten [the task] on thee, and they shall bear [it] with thee.

entries.title: Exodus 18:23
segments: If thou do this thing, and God command thee [so], thou wilt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

entries.title: Exodus 18:24
segments: And Moses hearkened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

entries.title: Exodus 18:25
segments: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of fifties, and chiefs of tens.

entries.title: Exodus 18:26
segments: And they judged the people at all times: the hard matters they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged.

entries.title: Exodus 18:27
segments: And Moses sent away his father-in-law, and he departed into his land.
